commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Referee Daniele Chiffi has finally had enough of Luciano Spalletti and brandishes a yellow card at him!
90+4' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Cremonese control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

87' Dennis Johnsen (Cremonese) is first to the rebound and attempts to beat the keeper from long range. It's a decent effort, but flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
87' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Cremonese win a free kick.
85' Here comes a substitution. Jonathan David (Juventus) is brought on as a substitute for Dusan Vlahovic.
85' Here is a change. Weston McKennie is going off and Luciano Spalletti gives the last tactical orders to Daniele Rugani (Juventus).
83' 1 - 2 Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Michele Di Gregorio with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:2.
83' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Filippo Terracciano leaves the pitch and Dennis Johnsen (Cremonese) comes on.
81' Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Juventus have a free kick.
79' Luciano Spalletti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Vasilije Adzic (Juventus) replacing Khephren Thuram.
79' Substitution. Joao Mario (Juventus) in, Filip Kostic out.
78' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
78' Great teamplay by Cremonese as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
74' Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
74' Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Juventus.
71' It is time for a substitution. Mikayil Faye (Cremonese) is on for Romano Floriani.
71' Davide Nicola has decided to substitute Federico Bonazzoli and he is replaced by Franco Vazquez (Cremonese).
71' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
70' Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) is penalised for holding. Daniele Chiffi signals a set piece. There is a free kick near the sideline to Juventus.
68' 0 - 2 Goal! Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 0:2.

66' What a miss! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
64' Luciano Spalletti decides to make a substitution. Lois Openda will be replaced by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus).
63' A cross from Martin Payero (Cremonese) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
62' Substitution. Warren Bondo walks off the pitch and Jeremy Sarmiento (Cremonese) comes on as a substitute.
60' Lois Openda (Juventus) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
59' A clumsy foul by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle. Cremonese have been awarded a free kick.
57' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
54' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

54' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Cremonese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
53' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) takes the corner with a short pass.
53' Martin Payero (Cremonese) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked. Corner kick. Cremonese will have an opportunity.
52' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
49' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the left side of the goal lacks power and Emil Audero easily makes the save.
48' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Cremonese earn a free kick.
47' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Lois Openda (Juventus) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
45+2' Cremonese seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
42' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
39' Cremonese are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

35' Lois Openda (Juventus) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
33' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus).

31' A neat pass finds Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the bottom left corner, but Emil Audero denies him with a good save.
30' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle after Martin Payero (Cremonese) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
29' Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
28' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

26' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Emil Audero has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save.
24' Filip Kostic (Juventus) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

23' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. That's a free kick to Juventus.
22' Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

22' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Cremonese, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
21' What an amazing save by Emil Audero! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the middle of the target, but fails.
19' Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Juventus have a free kick.
19' Juventus enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
17' Juventus failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
15' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
13' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
13' A raking crossfield pass from Weston McKennie (Juventus) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession. The ball is out of play and Juventus manage to earn a corner.
11' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle and signals a foul after Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) brought his opponent down. Cremonese are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
11' Filip Kostic (Juventus) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
10' Juventus can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' Lois Openda (Juventus) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
7' The Juventus players are exchanging some short passes.
5' A crossfield pass from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
2' 0 - 1 Goal! Filip Kostic (Juventus) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:1.
2' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

Juventus will kick the game off.
